A [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement]] '''ship''' belonged to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] member [[Hudu Shiv]]. He used the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] during an [[Mission to Vaced|assassination]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Shiv used the vessel as a decoy and it was destroyed by the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''; this successfully fooled the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] into thinking Shiv was dead.<ref name="SM 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hudu Shiv and his vessel appear in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2011]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''.
